units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:22">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> top <he>בפני כל ב׳ שלו</he> in the presence of the whole council over which he presided; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:6">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ</cite> top.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:2:4">Y. Yoma I, 39ᵃ</cite> top <cite ref="K00269"><he>כולי</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
Y. M. Kat. II, 81ᵇ אם הזכירוך לב׳ וכ׳ if they have mentioned (nominated) thee for the bulé, let the Jordan be thy neighbor, i.e. hide thyself in the bushes near the Jordan.
Ib. להפטר מב׳ to be exempt from serving in the bulé; Y. Snh. VIII, 26ᵇ top.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 6:4">Gen. R. s. 6</cite> <he>ב׳ ודימוס</he> senate and people (senatus populusque).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>וכן דימוס וכן כולם</he> (read <cite ref="B00264"><he>בולי</he></cite>) and so did the people and so the senate.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:2:8">Y. Ned. III, 38ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 3:8:3">Y. Shebu. III, 34ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כ״ד ב׳</he> twenty four city councils, i.e. cities or districts having their own councilmen; [Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Leviticus 7">Vayikra 7</cite>; Matt. 1 <he>ב׳ אלפים עיירות</he>]; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 22:1">Pesik. R. s. 22</cite> <cite ref="A01827"><he>אלות</he></cite> (read <cite ref="B00255"><he>בולאות</he></cite>).
